text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Being the ultimate idiot is cool." 
Because her Trainer told her that, Tosen 
Jordan runs with everything she's got.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That fiery passion spread to Nakayama 
Festa as well. "I'm aiming for the world. 
So you'd better take on a massive gamble 
that only you can pull off, too."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing those words, Tosen Jordan's mind 
began to race. If she was aiming to be the 
strongest, she wanted to run even better 
than the legendary Umamusume throughout 
history!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing her wish, the Trainer urged her to 
make it a reality at the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn). Fired up, she decided to invite 
Gold Ship to the race as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship refused, however, saying that 
this wasn't her showdown, but hers. 
Indeed, the Tenno Sho (Autumn) was Tosen 
Jordan's race.
